[Discussion] What is the most anime-like thing that has happened to you?

I've had a lot of anime like things happen to me. One that always come up whenever I think about it would be that one time in P.E class when we were playing hanball. I was on the defending team. One of the girls had the ball and was attempting to score. She went for the shot but I was quickly there to block her. Usually you'd just try to shove the blocking person aside or pass the ball. What she did though was attempt to jump over me and shoot. Anyway so she jumped flying straight towrds me. She crash into me and being the weak 6/7th grader I was I fall back and I landed nicely on my back with her boobs weighing down on my face. It took me a second to realize what had happened. At first I took in and enjoyed the moment a bit. Then I shoved her off me. I don't know what she thought would happen if she jumped at me with that speed but I'm pretty sure she did not excpect that.

I was a harem MC - an oblivious harem MC.

No, seriously.

See, I was a bit of an oddball in highschool. I went into freshman year after six years of homeschooling; six years in which pretty much my only social contact had been my two sisters, a kid in my neighborhood who was later diagnosed as a sociopath, and the internet. Thankfully, I was less "socially awkward" than "socially nonpresent," I got along just fine by sitting in class, reading my books, and running a mean 5:38 split for the cross-country team. Additionally, I'm accommodating to a fault. When the cafeteria was full, I'd be the one to give up my seat and eat my lunch standing at a counter rather than make someone else do it; I was the one to volunteer for junk labor duties and cleanup crews, the works.

In retrospect, this made me out to be some sort of mysterious, kindhearted loner, and the chicks digged it. Problem is, I was more oblivious than a particularly blind bat in a laser light show. What I saw as them trying to make me be social was, in fact, flirting.

My friends told me it was painful to watch, in a "Jesus Christ how is he that dense?" Kinda way. Relevant Terminal Lance.

So, how'd I find out?

  1. One confessed to me... in the parking lot, after prom, while I was puking from exhaustion and overwork. Oblivious as I was, she wasn't exactly girlfriend material anyway.
  2. One confessed after we graduated and she'd moved on to another guy. They're married now, cute couple, glad things worked out for her.
  3. One moved across the country in junior year, and a buddy asked me if I'd known she was crushing on me since we were freshmen.
  4. I overhead one mention it in another conversation at our first class reunion; the girls were chatting about one of the class' first marriages when "Hey Y, didn't you have a crush on Kaysic?" "Yeah, but you know how he was [laughter]." I didn't stick around.
Yeah. Highschool me was a goddamn moron.
